title: Security & Privacy GUI v1.1
description: Replace legacy Threat Control iframe with native Threats/Blocklist/Allowlist, cache bridge source discovery, restore persistence and verify responsive runtime on 8765/8766.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent';$patch=Join-Path $root 'patch-security-privacy-gui-v1.1.py';Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3en4all/3en-command-runner/main/scripts/patch-security-privacy-gui-v1.1.py?ts='+[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()) -OutFile $patch -TimeoutSec 30;$py=(Get-Command python.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source;if(-not $py){$py=(Get-Command py.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source};& $py $patch;if($LASTEXITCODE-ne0){throw 'GUI_V11_PATCH_FAILED'};$ui=Join-Path $root 'security-privacy-stack/3en-security-privacy-web.py';$br=Join-Path $root 'security-monitor-integration/3en-security-monitor-bridge-v1.py';$user=$env:USERNAME;$tr=New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn;$pr=New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId $user -LogonType Interactive -RunLevel Limited;$a1=New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute $py -Argument ('"'+$ui+'"');Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Security Privacy UI' -Action $a1 -Trigger $tr -Principal $pr -Force|Out-Null;$a2=New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute $py -Argument ('"'+$br+'"');Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Security Monitor Bridge' -Action $a2 -Trigger $tr -Principal $pr -Force|Out-Null;Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -and ($_.CommandLine -like '*3en-security-privacy-web.py*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*3en-security-monitor-bridge-v1.py*')}|ForEach-Object{Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue};Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Security Monitor Bridge';Start-Sleep -Seconds 2;Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Security Privacy UI';Start-Sleep -Seconds 4;Write-Host 'GUI_V11_RESTART=PASS'
repair: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Security Monitor Bridge' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;Start-Sleep -Seconds 2;Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Security Privacy UI' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
